After today's "special event" concluded, Apple has updated its official design resources website, adding new bezel assets for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Details are as follows.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro bezel assets are now available

For designers, Apple's design resources website should not be unfamiliar — the site offers various hardware and software assets, making it convenient for designers to use in their own work.

These assets come in file formats including Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG, covering Apple's major platforms, products, and technologies, including fonts, SF Symbols, the Icon Composer application, as well as logos and badges for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

Following today's announcement of the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro, Apple immediately updated the design resources website, providing Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include both the folded and unfolded forms of the iPhone Duo, with two color options available; as for the iPhone 18 Pro model, it features a smaller Dynamic Island.

To browse the new bezel assets and other existing resources on the Apple design resources website, please click here.
